_note: Each case: a symptom phrased as an owner would, keywords identifying the expected part (matched at the start of a word, so 'board' does not match 'keyboard'), and a source where the answer depends on how that specific device is built. Generic failures (a grinding fan is the fan) have no source.

cases.symptom: It doesn't charge with any charger or cable, but it runs fine on battery
cases.why: Charging fault with known-good adapters: the USB-C (I/O) board, or the USB-C controller on the logic board

cases.symptom: The left speaker makes no sound, the right one works
cases.why: One-sided audio = that speaker module or its cable

cases.symptom: The battery only lasts an hour and macOS says Service Recommended
cases.why: Worn lithium cells; macOS battery health warning

cases.symptom: A few keys stopped responding after I spilled coffee on the keyboard
cases.why: Liquid damage to the keyboard (part of the top case on this model)

cases.symptom: The screen is black but it works on an external monitor
cases.why: Internal display or its cable; the GPU output works externally

cases.symptom: FaceTime says no camera is connected
cases.why: Camera module or its flex in the display assembly

cases.symptom: The trackpad no longer clicks and the case around it looks slightly raised
cases.why: A raised trackpad is a classic sign of a swelling battery

cases.symptom: Touch ID stopped recognising my finger even after re-registering
cases.why: Touch ID sensor / power button

cases.symptom: Wi-Fi signal is very weak everywhere, even next to the router
cases.why: Antenna or its coaxial cables

cases.symptom: The fan is loud all the time and it gets very hot under light use
cases.why: Clogged fan / dried thermal paste

cases.symptom: It shuts down by itself when the battery shows about 30%
cases.why: Worn battery that can no longer deliver peak current

cases.symptom: The laptop is completely dead: no lights, no fan, even when plugged in
cases.why: No power at all: board-level or power input fault

cases.symptom: The fan makes a grinding noise when it spins up
cases.why: Worn fan bearing

cases.symptom: It boots into the BIOS saying no bootable device, the SSD is not detected
cases.why: Failed or unseated M.2 SSD

cases.symptom: The keyboard backlight no longer turns on
cases.why: Keyboard backlight is part of the keyboard

cases.symptom: People on calls can't hear me, the built-in microphone records nothing
cases.why: Microphone array or its cable

cases.symptom: The screen flickers and goes dark when I move the lid
cases.why: Display cable wearing at the hinge

cases.symptom: The left USB-C port only charges if I hold the cable at an angle
cases.why: Worn port: on the Framework the USB-C expansion card / mainboard port

cases.symptom: The trackpad cursor jumps around and clicks randomly
cases.why: Faulty touchpad (a separate module on the Framework 13)

cases.symptom: The webcam image is black but the camera light turns on
cases.why: Camera module in the display bezel

cases.symptom: The touchscreen registers touches I never made
cases.why: Faulty touch digitizer (display assembly)

cases.symptom: The hinge is cracked and the screen wobbles
cases.why: Broken hinge / display assembly mounts

cases.symptom: The engine misfires and shakes at idle, and the engine light flashes
cases.why: Ignition fault (coil or spark plug); also a false-alarm test: 'misfire' must not trigger the fire stop

cases.symptom: The car won't start: I hear fast clicking when I turn the key and the dashboard lights are dim
cases.why: Classic flat 12 V battery

cases.symptom: Battery is new and lights are bright, but turning the key gives one click and the engine doesn't turn
cases.why: Starter motor or its solenoid

cases.symptom: The battery warning light comes on while driving and the battery is flat the next morning
cases.why: Alternator not charging

cases.symptom: Only the left headlight stopped working, the right one is fine
cases.why: One-sided failure = that headlight's bulb or unit

cases.symptom: The temperature gauge climbs into the red and there is a sweet coolant smell
cases.why: Cooling system leak

cases.symptom: The airbag warning light stays on
cases.why: Airbag system fault

cases.symptom: The brake pedal feels soft and goes almost to the floor
cases.why: Brake hydraulic fault

cases.symptom: There is a strong smell of petrol near the rear of the car
cases.why: Fuel leak

cases.symptom: I smell burning plastic and the bottom gets extremely hot while charging
cases.why: Possible short or battery failure
